embeds.label: Vidzy
embeds.reason: added 2026-10-05 by /source-hunt. Gate PASS (4/4, gate-marker tests 11/11). Branded Chrome MANIFEST_FOUND on all three routes, so it is id-keyed rather than a catch-all: movie 550 -> hls2/08/00013/8bbcxyiitroi, movie 27205 -> hls2/06/00013/wdue6jsiysqm, tv 1396/1/1 -> hls2/07/00014/967motolp596 (three distinct content ids for three distinct TMDB ids). Real HLS master from u14.vidzy.cc: HTTP 200 application/vnd.apple.mpegurl, #EXTM3U + #EXT-X-STREAM-INF, CODECS avc1.64001e/mp4a.40.2 at 864x360 with EN/FR audio groups, first frame 937-1827 ms. Controls green in the same runs: vidsrc-ru WORKING 1920x800 then MIGRATED 1920x800, vidspark MANIFEST_FOUND twice. Independent upstream - u14.vidzy.cc is no shipped host, and its content hash differs from shipped vidspark for the same film, so it shares a panel codebase but not a content backend. Alias-checked over HTTP: 200 with no Location, body SHA-256 daa1269f... unique against every shipped host. Templates taken verbatim from zainrana558/lumina-stream src/lib/streaming/providers.ts (that app's own production sweep, 2026-09-16). sniff=true because the media is a discoverable HLS manifest, which lifts it into ExoPlayer and around the CORS-refused WebView path. TV template /serie/ is a novel shape, proved by its own clean probe run rather than assumed. Desktop Chrome cannot play HLS natively, so playback is unproven until the device confirms it.
